title: Resizing a zoom callout keeps its shape by default
goal: Dragging a corner or edge of a zoom callout's magnified box resizes it with the source box's aspect ratio locked, so the magnified picture never stretches or stops matching what it points at, and the magnification follows the size. Holding Shift frees the aspect (the source box changes shape to match, so the picture is still never stretched), the way pictures resize in Photonz and other Mac design apps.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-13): "when i resize the magnification window, it does not preserve aspect ratio by default". Context: the zoom callout in the user's previous screenshot (2026-10-12 18.46.00), a magnified box linked by leader lines to its source box.

From code reading (not run): ZoomCalloutBuilder.resized(_:to:) (PhotonzCore/ZoomCalloutEditing.swift:122-129) accepts any frame and sets magnification = frame.width / sourceRect.width; height is unconstrained, so the magnified box can take any shape. frame(for:of:) (:110-116) derives the box from the source size times magnification, which is what an aspect-locked resize should keep. The canvas drag lives in CanvasPointerDrags.swift. Check the Lens's resize too and apply the same default if the user would call it a 'magnification window'.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults: make a zoom callout, drag each corner and each edge of the magnified box; record in the audit the box and source aspect ratios and whether the picture stretches or crops

Corner drags keep the magnified box's aspect equal to the source box's (MEASURED within 0.5% at 10 sizes), anchored at the opposite corner (Option from the centre), and magnification = box width / source width; edge drags also keep the aspect, growing the other dimension around the edge's middle
Shift frees the aspect: the source box's shape changes to match the new box shape (same source centre, magnification from the width), so the magnified picture is never stretched
The magnification label and the panel slider update live during the drag; the result is one undo step
The source box's own handles keep working; resizing the source keeps the magnified box's aspect matching it the same way
Consistent with how other picture layers resize (state in the audit which modifier convention Photonz uses elsewhere and follow it)
A walk resizes a callout by a corner and an edge and checks the aspect ratios match the source, then with Shift and checks the picture is not stretched (pixel check)
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced on the pre-fix build at Next defaults (Z = Lens set to Magnify, drag 300,300 to 420,380 on settings-pane-2x.png): source 120x80 (3:2), box (444,260,240x160). Corner drag 684,420 -> 764,440 left the box 320x180 (1.78:1, 18.5% off the source) at 2.7x; right-edge drag 684,340 -> 744,330 left 276x160 (1.73:1) at 2.3x. Picture visibly stretched ('pture' pulled wide). Renderer scales box.w/src.w and box.h/src.h independently. Note: the canvas has NO source-box handles today (nothing on the canvas resizes the source), so acceptance item 5 has nothing to keep working; the core rule (box shape change reshapes the source) covers any future source handle. Option on a corner already means skew in Photonz, so there is no Option-from-centre; Photonz elsewhere uses Shift = keep proportions, free by default; callouts invert it (Photoshop's pixel-layer convention).

Shipped: ZoomCalloutBuilder.draggedFrame (PhotonzCore/ZoomCalloutEditing.swift) locks a handle drag to the SOURCE's aspect (corner holds opposite corner, edge grows the other side about its middle; a legacy stretched box comes back to the source shape on its first drag); Layer.resizeKeepsShapeByDefault flips Shift for callouts in CanvasPointerDrags; CanvasView.resizedFrame skips magnets for a shape-kept callout. ZoomCalloutBuilder.resized reshapes the source about its centre (width kept, height = box h / magnification) whenever the box gets another shape (Shift, typed H, group scale), so the picture can never stretch. DocumentRenderer scales the callout from the WHOLE source, so a source hanging off the canvas shows its overhang empty instead of stretching the rest (an extra composite only in that case; on-canvas sources render the same pixels). Tests: ZoomCalloutKeepsItsShapeTests (10 sizes, every corner, edges, Shift, legacy) + ZoomCalloutRenderingTests.aSourcePastTheCanvasEdgeIsNotStretched. New walk step expectCallout (keepsShape/magnification/unstretched pixel check), documented in playtest-harness.md, lock-safe by reading. The pixel check was shown to fail on a stretched picture (source reshape disabled temporarily: 11.4/255, threshold 4; honest reads 0.6-1.2). Walk green at Next defaults; callout*, lens, magnify-lens, crisp-zoom, a-dragged-lens walks green. Full suite 12890 green on the 4th run (runs 1-3 failed only 16ms wall-clock perf gates, folded into the-full-test-run-passes-every-time-not-one-run). Modifier convention elsewhere: Shift keeps proportions, Option on a corner skews, so no Option-from-centre.

left rough, not filed: the source region has no canvas handles of its own (acceptance item 5 assumed it had); only Shift on the box reshapes it. Not broken, nobody has asked for source handles; the core rule already keeps any future source handle in step.

A zoom callout's box now keeps its source's shape when a corner or edge is dragged (magnification follows the width); Shift frees it and the source reshapes about its centre, so the picture never stretches; one undo restores both. Reproduced on the old build first (3:2 source in a 1.78:1 box). Core: ZoomCalloutBuilder.draggedFrame/resized + Layer.resizeKeepsShapeByDefault; canvas drag flips Shift for callouts; renderer scales from the whole source. Verified: ZoomCalloutKeepsItsShapeTests + render test, new walk a-zoom-callout-keeps-its-shape-walk at Next defaults with new expectCallout pixel check (shown to fail on a stretched picture), neighbouring callout/lens walks green, full suite 12890 green.
